tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The two services Fedor offers — AI agent development and MCP server development — with a short summary and the page URL of each.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Case studies of real systems Fedor built. Filter by focus: 'agents', 'mcp', 'other' or 'all' (default). Returns slug, title, summary and URL; use get_case_study for the full text.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: The full text of one case study as Markdown, by slug (from list_case_studies).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search Fedor's blog posts by words in the title and summary, optionally limited to one tag (e.g. 'agents', 'mcp'). Returns up to 10 matches, newest first; use get_post for the full text.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: The full text of one blog post as Markdown, by slug (from search_posts).

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Fedor's express courses (plain-language explainers with a diagram per concept) on AI agents, MCP, RAG, evals, architecture, cloud and enterprise systems. Optionally filter by words in the title and summary. Returns slug, title, summary, level, reading time and URL; use get_course for the full text.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: The full text of one course as Markdown, by slug (from list_courses). Courses are long: each concept has a card with what it is, an example, the catch and related concepts.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: How to hire or contact Fedor: the contact form and services URLs, his time zone, languages and usual response time.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_services, list_case_studies, search_posts, get_post, list_courses, get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_services, list_case_studies, search_posts, get_post, list_courses, get_contact_info · Private data: get_contact_info · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
